paragraphs: A man of Kefar Darom, mentioned in a baraita in [Sotah 20a (20b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.20b.13-15) and in [Bamidbar Rabbah 9:31](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.9.31), in the dispute among Abba Yose ben Chanan, Rabbi Elazar ben Yitzchak and Rabbi Yishmael over how long a woman’s merit postpones her punishment. The opinion assigned to Rabbi Elazar of Kefar Darom is nine months. [Sifrei Naso, section 50 (8:1 in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Bamidbar.8.1) reads Rabbi Eliezer.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and Bamidbar Rabbah give Elazar ben Yitzchak of Kefar Darom the nine-month opinion. The linked Sifrei gives Eliezer. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=529&lang=en) also cites Sotah 20b and Bamidbar Rabbah 9.
